components_rich_editor_iscolselection: prosemirror-tables' CellSelection.isColSelection(), which checks whether a table selection spans one or more entire columns.
components_rich_editor_ju: A ProseMirror command helper that searches document nodes between positions, used with nodesBetween().
components_rich_editor_kd: A ProseMirror command helper (similar to wrapIn) that wraps a block range and scrolls the resulting selection into view.
components_rich_editor_ks: A ProseMirror content-fitting helper used when finding a fittable node during drag-and-drop or paste insertion.
components_rich_editor_locals: A ProseMirror ViewDesc helper that computes local decorations for a node's children.
components_rich_editor_m: A ProseMirror schema/input-rule helper used when parsing and joining matched content.
components_rich_editor_mark: A ProseMirror helper that applies a mark to newly inserted content, used with insertNode() and replaceSelectionWith().
components_rich_editor_mx: A tokenizer helper that checks whether an input rule accepts a given match, used with a linkify-style scanner.
components_rich_editor_n0: A ProseMirror JSON helper that (de)serializes a document node using a schema, used with fromSchema()/toJSON().
components_rich_editor_onselectionchange: A ProseMirror EditorView helper that responds to native DOM selection changes and flushes pending state updates.
components_rich_editor_parent: A ProseMirror ResolvedPos helper that resolves and returns a node's parent, used with addAttributes().
components_rich_editor_popevent: A ProseMirror history/collaboration helper that pops an event off the remapping stack.
components_rich_editor_qp: A prosemirror-tables helper that checks whether cells share the same markup (sameMarkup) while iterating nodes.
components_rich_editor_reconfigure: ProseMirror's EditorState.reconfigure(), which rebuilds editor state with an updated plugin/extension configuration.
components_rich_editor_recreatewrapper: A ProseMirror NodeView helper that recreates a node's DOM wrapper element.
components_rich_editor_registermutation: A ProseMirror DOM-observer helper that registers a detected DOM mutation for later processing.
components_rich_editor_removenodemark: ProseMirror's Transform.removeNodeMark(), which removes a specific mark from a node at a given position.
components_rich_editor_removestoredmark: A ProseMirror command helper that removes a mark from the editor's stored (pending) marks.
components_rich_editor_replacerange: ProseMirror's Transform.replaceRange(), which replaces a document range with new content while respecting node structure.
components_rich_editor_replacerangewith: ProseMirror's Transform.replaceRangeWith(), which replaces a document range with a single given node.
components_rich_editor_ry: A ProseMirror view helper that computes a DOM position from a document position (domFromPos).
components_rich_editor_sameset: ProseMirror's Mark.sameSet(), which checks whether two arrays of marks are identical.
components_rich_editor_setcursor: A ProseMirror drop-cursor plugin helper that positions the visual drop indicator during drag-and-drop.
components_rich_editor_setoptions: A ProseMirror EditorView constructor helper that applies view options and props when the view is created.
components_rich_editor_textblockfromcont: A ProseMirror helper that finds an appropriate textblock node type from the current content-match context.
components_rich_editor_tg: A ProseMirror wrapping helper that finds a valid node wrapping chain, used with findWrapping() and matchType().
components_rich_editor_tl: A ProseMirror ViewDesc helper related to computing local child decorations.
components_rich_editor_toformattedstring: A link/markdown scanner helper that renders a matched token into a formatted string representation.
components_rich_editor_toobject: A link/markdown scanner helper that converts a matched token into a plain object with its href and index.
components_rich_editor_tw: A ProseMirror step-mapping helper that validates a node reference against its parent's content.
components_rich_editor_ty: A ProseMirror view helper that reads the current DOM selection range.
components_rich_editor_unmount: A ProseMirror EditorView teardown helper that unmounts the view, removing its DOM and event listeners.
components_rich_editor_uo: A ProseMirror JSON schema helper used alongside document parsing/serialization functions.
components_rich_editor_virtualelement: A Filament rich-editor helper that constructs a virtual positioning element for floating toolbars/menus.
components_rich_editor_wg: A ProseMirror view helper that maps screen coordinates to document positions.
components_rich_editor_wy: A ProseMirror DOM-observer helper that stops observing DOM mutations when the view is destroyed.
